# Playback Authority Checklist: Android Media Shell

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for audio output authority, the engine handoff contract, focus classification, output routing, and pre-roll/rewind semantics
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [contracts/engine-handoff.md](../contracts/engine-handoff.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are single-authority requirements defined for every behaviour named in FR-042 (transport, rate, position, buffering, focus response, device-format conversion) without leaving any behaviour ownerless? [Completeness, Spec §FR-042]
- [x] CHK002 - Are requirements defined for what happens when the output device natively rejects the declared rate or shape (AAudio invalid-format / invalid-rate conditions)? [Gap, Spec §FR-033, Spec §FR-035]
- [x] CHK003 - Are requirements defined for Bluetooth output-device disappearance (A2DP disconnect), distinct from wired-headset removal? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for ordering when a device disappearance and a device appearance coincide in one route change (e.g. unplug wired while car Bluetooth connects)? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-017a]
- [x] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for a transient focus loss that is re-classified mid-interruption (e.g. a transient call becoming a permanent loss)? [Gap, Spec §FR-013a, Spec §FR-014]
      Reviewed 2026-10-05: covered by clarify session. FR-014 fixes latest-event-wins (clear transient flags, restore gain, explicit Play; late transient gain authorizes nothing); FR-015 rewind clock is cumulative from first yield; FR-041 window restarts at permanent loss; FR-039/FR-044 require two ordered append-only entries with supersede link.
- [x] CHK006 - Are pre-roll requirements defined for the full lifecycle: start trigger, refill on Play after idle, drain on idle, abandonment at session end? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015a, Spec §FR-015c]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is the noun holding playback authority unambiguously identified — the synthesis engine versus the Rust playback module — across FR-002, FR-003, FR-034, FR-042, and FR-043? [Ambiguity, Conflict, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the distinction between "resampling" (forbidden to the playback module) and "sample-format conversion" (owned by it) explicitly defined, including mono-to-stereo and width conversion? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-034]
- [x] CHK009 - Is "the output device's native sample format" defined with a measurable source (negotiated stream format versus device property)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-034]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the focus-classification axis explicitly fixed: the interrupting app's requested gain versus the focus-change event the system delivers when they disagree? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013a]
- [x] CHK011 - Is "approximately 20% of normal volume" quantified with a tolerance band and a measurement domain (output amplitude versus gain factor, device-minimum-volume interaction)? [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the rewind rule stated as a complete measurable formula: cursor displacement, sentence snap, and hard cap interaction when the containing sentence is longer than the cap? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 - Are the authority statements consistent between the spec ("the engine is the single authority") and the plan/data-model ("the player crate is the authority")? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §FR-002, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK014 - Are duck-versus-pause outcomes consistent between FR-013, FR-013a, FR-014, and the User Story 2 acceptance scenarios for every interrupter class (navigation, chime, call, alarm)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013a, Spec §US-2]
- [x] CHK015 - Are FR-015a (continuous preparation as written) and FR-015c (no preparation while idle) reconciled so that no requirement still mandates continuous pre-roll during an indefinite pause? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015a, Spec §FR-015c]
- [x] CHK016 - Are the privacy-direction rules consistent: following a newly appearing device automatically while never moving audio from a private output to a loudspeaker? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-017a]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK017 - Can "zero instances of the resume landing part-way through a word" be objectively measured given engines with no boundary events? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK018 - Can "total repetition never exceeding 30 seconds" be objectively verified across pause lengths and sentence lengths, including the sentence-longer-than-cap case? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK019 - Can "reduce to roughly 20% without stopping" be objectively verified per trial, including the device-minimum-volume edge? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK020 - Are success criteria defined for Bluetooth dropout and for simultaneous disappearance-plus-appearance route changes, or are those paths intentionally excluded? [Gap, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-033]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK021 - Are requirements defined for an interruption arriving while already ducked (compounding versus replacement outcome)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-013a]
- [x] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for rapid repeated Play presses with no dropped or phantom states? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for pre-roll behaviour when the rate changes while audio is pre-rolled but not playing? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019a, Spec §FR-015a]
- [x] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for pitch invariance across repeated rate transitions including pauses between them (accumulated drift)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019a, Spec §SC-015]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK025 - Are external audio-platform dependencies (AAudio stream negotiation, AudioFocusRequest grant semantics, BECOMING_NOISY versus A2DP callbacks) documented rather than assumed? [Dependency, Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
      Reviewed 2026-10-05: covered by clarify session. Assumptions now fix focus-request shape (GAIN + USAGE_MEDIA/CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH + willPauseWhenDucked + acceptsDelayedFocusGain + listener), app-side 15–25% duck depth, exact-request 22050 Hz/float/mono with refusal as FR-035, independent removal signals per FR-016a, and API-29-floor coverage (26/26/28/23).
- [x] CHK026 - Is the declared sample rate fixed at 22050 Hz by FR-033 (Assumptions and data-model DeclaredFormat agree), with only stream negotiation — never the value choice — left to plan, and does contracts/engine-handoff.md state the same value? [Traceability, Spec §FR-033, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK027 - Is a requirement and acceptance-criteria ID scheme established and applied consistently (FR-015a/015b/015c sequencing, FR-023a/023b/023c gaps)? [Traceability]
      Reviewed 2026-10-05: convention stated in spec Functional Requirements preamble (letter = derived, creation order, no reading order; every lettered FR cited by/cites an SC) and ratified in Clarifications 2026-10-02 + FR-044/SC-057. Spot-checked FR-015a/b/c and FR-023a/b/c: apparent order gaps are presentation order, permitted by the convention; no dangling derived requirement. Non-blocking nits only (stray Q&A line inside FR-023 block at spec.md:764; logical vs creation presentation).
